summary: the cases of tests/run bootpart under etude, against a /dev/bootpart listed while it is not published, a raw window whose writes are not bounded at its end, a /dev/grubcore that reaches the first sector of partition 1, and a raw seek that keeps its offset in 32 bits

argv: sh tests/proofs/guest.sh make rach2 && sh tests/proofs/guest.sh copy ${WORK} rach2/kernel

faults.name: listed-unpublished
faults.summary: /dev/bootpart is in /dev whether or not the boot disk's table qualified entry 1, so stat and open find it on a disk with no boot partition

faults.name: end-unbounded
faults.summary: a write of a raw window is not judged against the window's end before it goes down, so a write at or past the end reaches the driver and fails there with EIO, or lands past the window

faults.name: gap-past-end
faults.summary: /dev/grubcore on an MBR disk is published over LBA 1 through 2048, one sector into partition 1, in place of the gap that ends at LBA 2047

faults.name: seek-32
faults.summary: a seek of a raw window keeps the low 32 bits of the offset it resolves, so the end of the 260 GiB disk and its markers at 5 GiB and 258 GiB are out of reach
